title: Turán densities of complete 4-graphs: certificates, checkers and preprint
description:
Data package and preprint of the paper Turán densities of complete 4-graphs via flag algebras on seven vertices (Bruno Mérola Corrêa, 2026; the preprint is paper/turan4.pdf).

It contains the exact rational certificates behind every computer-assisted bound of the paper (among them π(K5(4)) < 0.69160 and σ(K5(4)) = 31/64), independent programs that re-check them from the certificate files alone, a single driver verifier/verify_all.sh that runs every check, and the search code that found the certificates. Every check was run end to end on clean cloud machines. Code: MIT (LICENSE-CODE); data and documentation: CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA).
